text:
Plate is about 26 cm. It holds four pizza squares with ham, pineapple and onion, roughly 50 g each, about 200 g in total and about 500 kcal. There is a generous pile of diced chicken, about 150 g and about 240 kcal. Pineapple chunks come to about 60 g and 30 kcal. Olives are about 20 g and 40 kcal, and cherry tomatoes about 70 g and 13 kcal. That totals about 500 g and 823 kcal.
